sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: External link previews on MusicBrainz (new setting "Preview external links on hover", off by default). Hold Ctrl over a link to another site — in a table such as an event's "URLs" list, a relationship, the annotation or the sidebar's external links — for a card with the page's title, site, image and description, and with the relationship the link is ("MusicBrainz: setlist.fm of this event"). Every card shows the link's status: a dead link (404, 410) says the page is gone, a page that moved to another site or path shows where it went (an http link now served over https on the same address only says "→ https", and parameters a site adds on the way, such as YouTube's consent detour, are no move), a site's bot check (Cloudflare's "Just a moment…", AWS WAF's "Human Verification", whatever status it comes with) is shown as such, naming who checks, and never as a dead link, and a PDF or an image is named from its headers without being downloaded. Space pins the card into a window with the page's details and the page itself (Live page, without its scripts); ← → step down the column. YouTube videos and playlists get a card from YouTube's oEmbed service (title, channel, thumbnail) instead of the page, which without its scripts shows nothing: their window has no Live page. A page that puts its title and description far down (past the first 512 KB) still gets them. Cards show the linked site's icon (new setting "Show the sites' icons", on by default): asked once per site and kept for a month, without your cookies and only from the site itself, never from another server, and never for a site not contacted yet. Without an icon, a letter stands for the site: the first of its name, skipping prefixes such as www., a country or a language (us.7digital.com shows "7", not "U"). A Live page that cannot be loaded says "Could not load the page.", not "detail page". The request goes to the linked site WITHOUT your cookies, so the card shows the page everyone sees. The first time a site is contacted Tampermonkey asks whether the script may: a site never contacted before is therefore loaded only when you press Space (or tap the link on a touch screen), never by hovering, and after one answer its links load on hover too. Answers are kept for a week ("Keep external answers for (hours)"); a dead link or a browser check only until the page is reloaded.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Popup engine (org/iframe.org, "* generalize to URLs", U1): a source for links to other sites, _extSource(), placed before the MusicBrainz entity cards (the two never claim the same link). Requests go through _extFetch() — GM_xmlhttpRequest with anonymous: true, aborted at the headers for a non-page — and _extAwaitSlot(), one second apart per host. Records load through _mbLoad(), which takes its own time to live (ttlMs, passed to _rgIdbGet()); only a readable page is kept in IndexedDB. Hosts that answered once are kept in the GM value sa_pop_ext_hosts (the script's state: not a setting, not exported). _dpGetRaw() takes a source's own fetchText and a URL-aware awaitSlot, so the Live page can read another site. _mbPopSteps() now calls the shared _popColumnSteps(). Readers (_EXT_READERS: YouTube via oEmbed, then the generic one) carry their kind, the host they ask (askHost, for first contact) and noLive, which hides the window's Live page button. _dpLiveDocHtml() drops preload/prefetch/preconnect links for every source (Chrome warned about the unused preloads).

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: New tests/fixtures/popup-ext.spec.js (13 tests) and popup-ext.mobile.spec.js (a tap opens the window); new scripts/mutations/popup-ext.json (36 mutations); four popup-mb.json anchors re-anchored on _popColumnSteps(). The GM_xmlhttpRequest test stub (tests/support/gmStubs.js) logs every call and can answer with headers, a final URL, an error or a timeout; the live specs' real-network passthrough (tests/support/realNetworkGmXhr.js) passes headers and the final URL too. New @extended live spec tests/live/popup-ext.spec.js on the event page of the request. HELP, docs/claude/detail-pages.md, CLAUDE.md, org/iframe.org.
